title: Sum of Subarray Ranges
summary: Given an integer array, calculate the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values for every possible contiguous subarray.
statement: Given an integer array, calculate the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values for every possible contiguous subarray.
constraints: nums is nonempty and may contain negative or repeated values.
The range of a subarray is its maximum minus its minimum.
Return the sum of ranges over every nonempty contiguous subarray.
hints: Fixing the left endpoint lets each extension update its extrema in constant time.
For every left endpoint, carry the smallest and largest values while moving right.
Each subarray is visited exactly once at its endpoints, and the maintained extrema equal that subarray’s range.
editorial: Each subarray is visited exactly once at its endpoints, and the maintained extrema equal that subarray’s range.

tests.explanation: The length-two ranges are one and one, and the length-three range is two, totaling four.
The ranges are zero for singletons, two for [1,3] and [1,3,3], and zero for [3,3], totaling four.
